verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a dedicated Order MCP server whose get_order tool fetches the current state of an order the agent placed, including line items, fulfillment events and post-purchase adjustments. The UCP CLI and quickstart explicitly cover tracking an order after purchase, and UCP order webhooks push full order state on fulfillment, refund, return and cancellation changes. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of get_order or order tracking (runtime probes stopped at cart creation), access beyond Token-tier agents with the read_global_api_orders scope, self-serve webhook subscription (it currently requires contacting a partner manager), and explicit documentation of carrier tracking numbers or URLs in the order payload.
